summary: Citius Oncology filed an 8-K on April 29, 2026, announcing the initial international shipment of its drug LYMPHIR (denileukin diftitox-cxdl) to Europe via a regional distribution partner. The drug will be available through Named Patient Programs under local regulations. No financial terms, transaction structure, or board actions regarding a corporate change are disclosed. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 describes a routine commercial milestone, not a special-situation event. The filing contains only operational updates on product distribution and does not trigger any M&A, restructuring, or capital markets classification.
